reference_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id
FROM orders o
WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND o.store_id = 25
  AND year(o.order_ts) = 2024
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders o2
    WHERE o2.customer_id = o.customer_id
      AND year(o2.order_ts) = 2025
  )

SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
FROM orders
WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND store_id = 25
  AND year(order_ts) = 2024
  AND customer_id NOT IN (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE year(order_ts) = 2025
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
  )

other_way.sql:
SELECT customer_id
FROM orders
WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND store_id = 25
  AND year(order_ts) = 2024
EXCEPT
SELECT customer_id
FROM orders
WHERE year(order_ts) = 2025
other_way.tradeoff: EXCEPT takes the 2025 customers away from the 2024 ones in fewer lines, but works only when you return the key alone.
